name: creditsync
description: Private CreditSync borrower, payment, loan replacement, intermediary-remittance and disbursement, floating-interest settlement, renewal, reversal, and deterministic workflow-resolution guidance for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review and manage private CreditSync workflows.
interface.longDescription: Use the private CreditSync app to resolve borrowers and intermediaries, cancel eligible unposted intermediary collections, reconcile intermediary remittances and multi-leg disbursements, manage and settle effective-dated floating interest, capture evidence, post allocations, renew daily loans, and create audited reversals.
defaultPrompt: Find a borrower and show outstanding loans.
Preview a single-payment loan settlement and replacement contract.
Record a loan disbursement with evidence.
Record an assigned intermediary three-leg disbursement with evidence.
Schedule a future floating-loan interest rate.
Reverse an exact executed floating-loan settlement after confirmation.
